title: Flatness of polynomial local prefix quotients passes from finite coefficient subrings
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $R_0\subseteq R$ a finite type integer subring [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Fix $f_1,\ldots,f_c\in R_0[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], a prime ideal $Q$ of $R[x]$, and an integer $i\geq0$. For every finite type integer subring $B$ containing $R_0$, put $Q_B=Q\cap B[x]$ and let $f_{j,B}$ be the coefficientwise image of $f_j$. Suppose $B[x]_{Q_B}/(f_{1,B},\ldots,f_{\min(i,c),B})$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is flat over $B$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $R[x]_Q/(f_{1,R},\ldots,f_{\min(i,c),R})$ is flat over $R$. No complete-intersection, equation-containment or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Second paragraph of the proof of part (2), the displayed filtered colimit of prefix quotients, and the application of Tag 05UU (2).

proof.text: Apply the backward equational criterion (Mathlib Module.Flat.of_forall_isTrivialRelation, Stacks 00HK). Given a finite relation in the full prefix quotient, choose localized representatives x_j of its elements. Quotient.mk linearity says that sum_j r_j*x_j belongs to the localized prefix ideal.

Clear a common denominator d outside Q for all x_j, using IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples_of_finite, so f(z_j)=f(d)*x_j. Set v=sum_j C(r_j)*z_j. Then f(v) belongs to the extension of the polynomial prefix ideal. IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff supplies t outside Q with t*v in that polynomial ideal. Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun writes t*v as sum_j cs_j*f_j. These are Mathlib localization and finitely generated ideal identities, not unproved library dependencies.

Construct B as the underlying subring of Algebra.adjoin R0 of the finite set of scalars r_j and coefficients of d,t,z_j,cs_j. It contains R0 and is finite type over R0, hence over the integers. MvPolynomial.mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset lifts the selected polynomials to B. Their coefficient inclusion is injective, transferring the identity sum cs_j*f_j=t*v to B. The lifted d and t remain outside the contracted prime. IsLocalization.map constructs the canonical local ring map phi; take y_j=z_B,j/d_B. IsLocalization.mk'_spec and the localized ideal-membership criterion show sum a_j*y_j belongs to the stage prefix ideal, and phi(y_j)=x_j.

Coefficient-map composition shows phi carries each prefix generator to its full-ring image. Ideal.quotientMap therefore constructs the map psi from the stage quotient to the full quotient. Compatibility on constant polynomials proves psi(b*z)=b*psi(z), with b included into R. The lifted relation is zero in the stage quotient.

Use hstage for B. The forward equational criterion (Module.Flat.isTrivialRelation_of_sum_smul_eq_zero) gives a coefficient matrix d_js and stage quotient elements z_s trivializing the lifted relation. Map z_s through psi and include the matrix into R. Mapping the element expansions proves the original element expansions, and applying B.subtype to the coefficient zero equations gives the required zero equations over R. This closes the backward equational criterion. Empty relations, empty prefixes, overlong prefixes and zero quotient modules are covered by the same finite sums and list operations.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00SV (finite coefficient descent), 05UU (2), and 00HK (equational criterion). Direct finite-relation version of the colimit argument; fully proved in Lean by M2.

lean.statement:
theorem flat_polynomial_local_quotient_of_finiteType_subrings
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (R₀ : Subring R)
    (hR₀ : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R₀) {n c : ℕ}
    (f₀ : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R₀)
    (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) [Q.IsPrime] (i : ℕ)
    (hstage : ∀ (B : Subring R) (hB : R₀ ≤ B), Algebra.FiniteType ℤ B →
      Module.Flat B
        (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype)) ⧸
          Ideal.ofList (((List.ofFn
            (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.map (Subring.inclusion hB) (f₀ j))).map
              (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) B)
                (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (MvPolynomial.map B.subtype))))).take i))) :
    Module.Flat R (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸
      Ideal.ofList (((List.ofFn (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.map R₀.subtype (f₀ j))).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.AtPrime Q))).take i))
